specs.name: 100% Free Catalog ($0/mo)
specs.verificationMethod: HTTP 200 stream access without subscription checkout wall
specs.description: Full playable broadcast catalog is accessible at $0/month without a recurring subscription paywall or credit card gate.

specs.name: Instant Play (No Account Login)
specs.verificationMethod: Unauthenticated curl / browser audio playback test
specs.description: Listeners and external clients can stream audio immediately without registering an account or maintaining session cookies.

specs.name: Zero Mid-Roll or Display Ads
specs.verificationMethod: DOM ad-network script audit & audio stream inspection
specs.description: Zero third-party banner ads, pop-unders, or modern programmatic mid-roll audio ads spliced into historical broadcasts.

specs.name: Public Recording UUID / RID Index
specs.description: Every broadcast and recording has a permanent, canonical public UUID and short RID decoupled from storage URLs—enabling any external media player, catalog, or addon to resolve verified metadata, multi-mirror audio streams, and .vtt subtitles by ID.

specs.name: SHA-256 Audio Stream Deduplication
specs.verificationMethod: Cryptographic sha256 stream digest manifest per recording
specs.description: Every audio file across public mirrors is fingerprinted by SHA-256 hash to merge identical mislabeled trader files while preserving distinct East/West Coast network broadcasts.

specs.name: Schema.org RadioEpisode JSON-LD
specs.verificationMethod: <script type="application/ld+json"> DOM inspection on episode URLs
specs.description: Every broadcast page embeds structured Schema.org RadioEpisode / RadioSeries JSON-LD and OpenGraph metadata for search engines and AI agents.

specs.name: Per-Series Podcast RSS Feeds
specs.description: Dedicated RSS 2.0 / Apple Podcasts enclosure feed generated for every individual series rather than a single 10-episode sampler feed.

specs.name: Public JSON API & /llms.txt
specs.description: Exposes structured JSON metadata endpoints and a static /llms.txt index without CAPTCHA or API key paywalls.

specs.name: 100% Full-Length .vtt Subtitles
specs.verificationMethod: Time-synced WebVTT (.vtt) track covering 100% of audio duration
specs.description: Complete start-to-finish word-timed WebVTT (.vtt) caption tracks generated across the full recording length via faster-whisper VAD (never 30–90s snippets).

specs.name: Primary Newspaper & Trade Log Scans
specs.verificationMethod: Linked newspaper clipping / trade magazine scan citations
specs.description: Air dates corroborated by linked primary scans from Library of Congress Chronicling America, Fulton History, JJonz RadioLogs, Variety, Broadcasting, and Radio Daily.

specs.name: Original Studio Broadcast Scripts
specs.verificationMethod: Linked archival script PDF/text in episode record
specs.description: Links surviving network continuity and studio production scripts directly to the corresponding broadcast record.

specs.name: Per-Episode Actor ↔ Character Graph
specs.description: Maps each credited actor to the specific character role played in that individual broadcast rather than pasting generic series leads.

specs.name: 16" ET Disc / Lossless FLAC Streams
specs.verificationMethod: Audio stream Content-Type & bitrate >= 128 kbps / FLAC inspection
specs.description: Provides uncompressed FLAC/WAV or high-bitrate (>=128 kbps) transfers sourced from 16-inch 33⅓ RPM electrical transcription discs rather than 24–56 kbps MP3 dubs.

specs.name: Sequential Multi-Part Serial Arcs
specs.verificationMethod: Chronological multi-part episode ordering on series pages
specs.description: Preserves contiguous multi-part serial story arcs (e.g., 5-part Johnny Dollar, I Love a Mystery) in chronological sequence instead of alphabetical title shuffle.

presets.name: Casual Listener
presets.scenarioTitle: Stream any classic radio series immediately with zero ads and $0 subscription cost

presets.name: Universal Player / AI Agent
presets.scenarioTitle: Resolve streams, .vtt subtitles, and JSON-LD metadata by canonical public recording UUID

presets.name: Archival Historian
presets.scenarioTitle: Newspaper-corroborated air dates, linked studio scripts, and per-episode character roles

presets.name: 16" ET Collector
presets.scenarioTitle: High-bitrate 16-inch transcription disc transfers, FLAC availability, and SHA-256 dedup
